description: Create a new Radix Wiki page. Requires a ROLA bearer token — see https://radix.wiki/AGENTS.md for the challenge-sign-verify flow. Call get_categories first for a valid tagPath. Some paths are balance-gated (blog needs 50,000 $XRD). Earns contribution points.

content.description: Array of typed blocks. Each needs a unique `id` (UUID) and a `type`. A `content` block carries semantic HTML in `text`; an `infobox` block carries nested `blocks`. Start with an infobox, hyperlink every assertion to its source, no inline styles.

metadata.description: Key-value metadata for the page, including `excerpt` (one sentence, ≤160 chars). Some tag paths require specific keys — the error names any that are missing.

slug.description: URL slug (derived from the title when omitted)

tagPath.description: Tag path the page lives under (e.g. "contents/tech/core-concepts")

name: create_page
title: Create a page
